themes.name: Server attitude and attentiveness
themes.description: Reviews about how waiters and waitresses treated guests: friendliness, rudeness, attentiveness, knowledge of the menu, checking in, refilling drinks, and being helpful or dismissive.

themes.name: Hostess and seating policy
themes.description: Reviews about the host stand and seating experience: hostess attitude, refusal or reluctance to seat parties or walk-ins, party-size rules, table placement, and lost or mishandled reservations.

themes.name: Wait times and reservations
themes.description: Reviews about how long guests waited for a table, whether reservations were needed or honored, and how busy the restaurant was.

themes.name: Pace of service
themes.description: Reviews about how quickly or slowly drinks, bread, and food arrived, the order and timing of courses, and feeling rushed or ignored during the meal.

themes.name: Prices and portion sizes
themes.description: Reviews about cost, value for money, and the size of dishes, including small plates or entrees judged too small, overpriced, or well worth the cost.

themes.name: Hype and expectations
themes.description: Reviews that compare the restaurant to its reputation, ratings, awards, media coverage, and recommendations, saying it did or did not live up to the buzz.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the fried alligator appetizer, including its texture, seasoning, breading, and chili garlic aioli.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the wood-fired or roasted oysters with chili garlic butter, including their flavor, size, temperature, and sauce.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon entree
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the signature Louisiana Cochon pork dish with cabbage, turnips, cracklins, and pickled peaches, including its moisture, flavor, and portion.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the rabbit and dumplings entree, including the amount of rabbit, seasoning, and overall flavor.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the macaroni and cheese casserole side dish, whether it is praised as a standout or called bland, salty, or ordinary.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the braised pork cheek dish, including its tenderness, seasoning, and accompaniments.

themes.name: Smoked pork ribs
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the smoked pork ribs with watermelon pickle, including tenderness, sauce, spice, and smokiness.

themes.name: Boudin balls
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the fried boudin, including its texture, seasoning, and the pickled peppers and mustard served with it.

themes.name: Saltiness and seasoning
themes.description: Reviews that discuss whether dishes across the menu were too salty, bland, or under or over seasoned.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the complimentary rolls and bread basket, including quality, freshness, and whether refills were given.

themes.name: Cocktails and bar
themes.description: Reviews that discuss cocktails, bourbon and whiskey selections, wine and beer lists, drink strength, bartenders, and sitting at the bar.

themes.name: Atmosphere and noise
themes.description: Reviews about the ambiance, decor, music, noise level, crowding, table spacing, temperature, and overall feel of the dining room.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Reviews that discuss the desserts, such as pineapple upside-down cake, butterscotch pudding, chocolate cake, and other sweets.

themes.name: Check handling
themes.description: Reviews about paying the bill, including refusal to split checks, billing errors, comps, and the presentation of the check.

themes.name: Cleanliness and food safety
themes.description: Reviews about hygiene and safety, including pests, foreign objects in food, undercooked or cold food, illness after eating, and allergy concerns.

themes.name: Discrimination and unwelcoming treatment
themes.description: Reviews that allege guests were treated differently or turned away because of race, ethnicity, appearance, or party type.
